items.en: The students are decorating the art classroom.
items.zh: 同学们正在装饰美术教室。

items.en: Look at this yellow star, Brian and Jenny!
items.zh: 布莱恩、詹妮，快看这颗黄色的星星！

items.en: Isn’t it beautiful?
items.zh: 它是不是很漂亮？

items.en: I’m going to hang it from the ceiling over the desk.
items.zh: 我要把它挂在课桌上方的天花板上。

items.en: Here is the tape.
items.zh: 胶带给你。

items.en: I’ll get the ladder for you.
items.zh: 我去给你拿梯子。

items.en: I don’t need a ladder.
items.zh: 我不需要梯子。

items.en: I think I’m tall enough.
items.zh: 我觉得我够高了。

items.en: Danny can’t reach the ceiling, so he climbs onto Mr Green’s chair.
items.zh: 丹尼够不到天花板，就爬上了格林老师的椅子。

items.en: Almost… Almost… Aaaaaaahhhh!
items.zh: 快了……快了……啊啊啊啊啊！

items.en: Danny falls.
items.zh: 丹尼摔了下来。

items.en: What was that noise?!
items.zh: 什么声音？！

items.en: He sees Danny lying on the floor.
items.zh: 他看见丹尼躺在地上。

items.en: Danny, are you okay?
items.zh: 丹尼，你没事吧？

items.en: Are you hurt?
items.zh: 受伤了吗？

items.en: Hmm… My tail is a little sore, but it’s not serious.
items.zh: 嗯……我的尾巴有点疼，不过不严重。

items.en: Then, they hear Brian cry for help, but his voice is very weak.
items.zh: 接着，他们听见布莱恩在喊救命，可声音很微弱。

items.en: Brian?
items.zh: 布莱恩？

items.en: Where are you?
items.zh: 你在哪儿？

items.en: Help me, sir!
items.zh: 老师，救救我！

items.en: I’m under Danny!
items.zh: 我在丹尼底下！

items.en: Oh no!
items.zh: 哦不！

items.en: I’m really sorry!
items.zh: 我真的很抱歉！

items.en: Are you okay, Brian?
items.zh: 布莱恩，你没事吧？

items.en: No, I’m opposite of okay.
items.zh: 不，我可一点也不好。

items.en: I tried to catch you, but you landed on top of me.
items.zh: 我想接住你，结果你砸在了我身上。

items.en: My arm hurts.
items.zh: 我胳膊疼。

items.en: Should I call an ambulance?
items.zh: 要我叫救护车吗？

items.en: No, that’s not necessary.
items.zh: 不用，没必要。

items.en: I don’t think my arm is broken.
items.zh: 我觉得胳膊没骨折。

items.en: Jenny, please call Brian’s mother.
items.zh: 詹妮，请你给布莱恩的妈妈打个电话。

items.en: Tell her we are taking Brian to the hospital.
items.zh: 告诉她我们正带布莱恩去医院。

items.en: He should get an X-ray just in case.
items.zh: 为保险起见，他得拍个 X 光片。

items.en: Today is National Safety Education Day.
items.zh: 今天是全国安全教育日。

items.en: Our school organised activities to teach us about safety.
items.zh: 学校组织了活动，教我们安全知识。

items.en: The first part was fire safety.
items.zh: 第一部分是消防安全。

items.en: What should people do in case of a fire emergency?
items.zh: 发生火灾时该怎么做？

items.en: A firefighter gave us a talk and showed us videos.
items.zh: 一位消防员给我们做了讲座，还放了视频。

items.en: He said that if there is a fire, we should stay calm, find the nearest exit to go outside, and never use lifts.
items.zh: 他说万一着火，要保持冷静，找最近的出口出去，千万别坐电梯。

items.en: We even had a fire drill!
items.zh: 我们还进行了消防演练！

items.en: As soon as the fire alarm rang, all the students took action.
items.zh: 火警铃一响，全体同学立刻行动。

items.en: We covered our mouths and noses with wet towels.
items.zh: 我们用湿毛巾捂住口鼻。

items.en: We walked down the stairs calmly and in order.
items.zh: 我们安静有序地走下楼梯。

items.en: Our teachers guided us outside.
items.zh: 老师把我们带到室外。

items.en: After the drill, the firefighter taught us how to put out a fire with water or with a fire extinguisher.
items.zh: 演练后，消防员教我们怎么用水或灭火器灭火。

items.en: We did it!
items.zh: 我们做到了！

items.en: Later, we learned some first aid skills, like CPR and other basic life support training.
items.zh: 后来我们学了些急救技能，比如心肺复苏和其他基础生命支持训练。

items.en: We talked about online safety practices and where to find help in any emergency.
items.zh: 我们讨论了网络安全做法，以及遇到紧急情况去哪儿求助。

items.en: We discussed how to stay safe in a big crowd, and what to do to avoid drowning.
items.zh: 我们讨论了在人群中怎么保护自己，还有怎样避免溺水。

items.en: The safety education activities helped us understand how to stay safe and make good choices in different situations.
items.zh: 这些安全教育活动让我们明白，在不同场合怎样保护自己、做出正确选择。

items.en: It was a beautiful noon.
items.zh: 那是个美好的中午。

items.en: I was riding my bicycle by the river, thinking about yesterday’s baseball game.
items.zh: 我正沿着河边骑车，想着昨天的棒球赛。

items.en: I guess I rode over a hole in the road.
items.zh: 我猜是压到了路上的一个坑。

items.en: All of a sudden, WHAM!
items.zh: 突然，砰！

items.en: I went down hard on my right side.
items.zh: 我右侧重重地摔了下去。

items.en: That really hurt!
items.zh: 真疼啊！

items.en: My head hit the ground.
items.zh: 我的头磕到了地上。

items.en: I lay there for a few minutes.
items.zh: 我在地上躺了几分钟。

items.en: I tried to get up, but I couldn’t!
items.zh: 我想爬起来，却起不来！

items.en: “There’s something wrong with me,” I thought.
items.zh: 我心想：「我肯定是哪儿不对劲。」

items.en: I felt so terrible that I lay down again.
items.zh: 我难受极了，又躺了回去。

items.en: Then I saw blood on my shoe.
items.zh: 接着我看见鞋上有血。

items.en: My hand and knee were bleeding.
items.zh: 我的手和膝盖都在流血。

items.en: I was in a lot of pain.
items.zh: 我疼得厉害。

items.en: As I lay there, I took off my helmet.
items.zh: 躺着的时候，我摘下了头盔。

items.en: There was a sharp rock sticking out of it.
items.zh: 上面扎着一块尖石头。

items.en: It was pretty scary to look at.
items.zh: 看着真吓人。

items.en: Thank goodness I wore my helmet!
items.zh: 谢天谢地，我戴了头盔！

items.en: I shouted for help.
items.zh: 我大声呼救。

items.en: A driver stopped his truck and came to help me.
items.zh: 一位司机停下车，过来帮我。

items.en: He put my bike in the back of his truck and drove me to the hospital.
items.zh: 他把我的自行车放到车斗里，开车送我去了医院。

items.en: When my mother got to the hospital, she gave me a big hug and kiss.
items.zh: 妈妈赶到医院时，紧紧抱住我、亲了亲我。

items.en: “You were wearing your helmet this time.
items.zh: 「这次你戴了头盔。

items.en: How lucky you were!” she said.
items.zh: 多幸运啊！」她说。

items.en: She knew I was careless and did not always wear my helmet.
items.zh: 她知道我马虎，以前并不总戴头盔。

items.en: But I’ll never be careless again...
items.zh: 可我再也不会马虎了……

items.en: My bicycle helmet saved my life!
items.zh: 我的自行车头盔救了我的命！

items.en: NORTH TOWN, Alberta.
items.zh: 阿尔伯塔省北镇。

items.en: Thirteen-year-old Ann Brown was hit by a car outside North Town Primary School at 15 Park Road.
items.zh: 13 岁的安·布朗在公园路 15 号北镇小学外被车撞了。

items.en: The accident happened at about 7:30 a.m.
items.zh: 事故大约发生在早上 7 点半。

items.en: She and her brother, James, were on their way to an early basketball practice.
items.zh: 她和哥哥詹姆斯正赶去参加早上的篮球训练。

items.en: “We were in a hurry,” James told the reporter.
items.zh: 「我们当时很着急，」詹姆斯告诉记者。

items.en: “We didn’t want to be late for practice.
items.zh: 「我们不想训练迟到。

items.en: Ann’s basketball rolled onto the street.
items.zh: 安的篮球滚到了马路上。

items.en: She raced to get it.”
items.zh: 她冲过去捡球。」

items.en: Mrs Andrews, a chemistry teacher from Green Wood School, was walking several steps behind the two students.
items.zh: 绿林学校的化学老师安德鲁斯夫人走在两个学生后面几步远。

items.en: She saw it happen.
items.zh: 她亲眼看见了这一幕。

items.en: “I don’t know whose fault it was,” Mrs Andrews said.
items.zh: 「我不知道是谁的错，」安德鲁斯夫人说。

items.en: “The girl didn’t see the car.
items.zh: 「那女孩没看见车。

items.en: And the street was icy — the car couldn’t stop in time.
items.zh: 路面又结了冰——车没能及时停下。

items.en: It was terrible.”
items.zh: 太可怕了。」

items.en: Mrs Andrews said, “I shouted to the girl.
items.zh: 安德鲁斯夫人说：「我朝那女孩喊了。

items.en: I wanted to stop her from running after the ball, but she didn’t hear me.”
items.zh: 我想拦住她别去追球，可她没听见。」

items.en: After the accident, the car stopped, and the driver, Bill Morin, jumped out.
items.zh: 事故发生后，车停了下来，司机比尔·莫林跳下车。

items.en: He called an ambulance.
items.zh: 他叫了救护车。

items.en: Mr Morin knows first aid.
items.zh: 莫林先生懂急救。

items.en: He did not move Ann.
items.zh: 他没有搬动安。

items.en: He stopped traffic on the road until the ambulance came.
items.zh: 他拦住路上的车，一直等到救护车来。

items.en: Then the ambulance took both students to the hospital.
items.zh: 随后救护车把两个学生都送去了医院。

items.en: Both kids were in shock.
items.zh: 两个孩子都受到了惊吓。

items.en: Ann has a broken leg and a bad shoulder wound.
items.zh: 安一条腿骨折，肩膀也伤得很重。

items.en: She is recovering in the hospital.
items.zh: 她正在医院里恢复。

items.en: Doctors say she can expect to return to school in about a week.
items.zh: 医生说她大约一周后就能返校。

items.en: Many serious accidents happen in people’s homes.
items.zh: 很多严重事故发生在家里。

items.en: The kitchen and the bathroom are the two most dangerous places in the house.
items.zh: 厨房和浴室是家里最危险的两个地方。

items.en: Can people prevent certain accidents?
items.zh: 有些事故能预防吗？

items.en: Yes.
items.zh: 能。

items.en: Many accidents happen because people are careless.
items.zh: 很多事故都是因为人粗心。

items.en: So be careful!
items.zh: 所以一定要小心！

items.en: Be careful with fire and boiling water when you cook.
items.zh: 做饭时当心火和开水。

items.en: Have fire blankets, fire extinguishers, smoke alarms, and flashlights near the kitchen.
items.zh: 厨房附近要备好灭火毯、灭火器、烟雾报警器和手电筒。

items.en: Always turn off the oven or stove after use.
items.zh: 用完烤箱或炉灶，一定要关掉。

items.en: In case of a gas leak, do not use a cell phone or any electric item.
items.zh: 万一漏气，别用手机，也别碰任何电器。

items.en: Immediately turn off the stove and quickly open a window.
items.zh: 马上关掉炉灶，赶紧开窗。

items.en: Move to a safe area to inform emergency services and the gas company.
items.zh: 到安全的地方再联系急救部门和燃气公司。

items.en: Never use electricity in the shower or bathtub.
items.zh: 淋浴或泡澡时绝不要用电。

items.en: It can shock you!
items.zh: 会触电的！

items.en: Be sure to keep the bathroom floor dry after you take a shower or bath.
items.zh: 洗完澡一定把浴室地面擦干。

items.en: It’s easy to slip and fall on a wet floor.
items.zh: 地上有水很容易滑倒。

items.en: Turn on the cold water first when taking a bath.
items.zh: 洗澡时先开冷水。

items.en: Then adjust the hot water to ensure a safe water temperature.
items.zh: 再调热水，把水温调到安全。

items.en: Hot water can burn you.
items.zh: 热水会烫伤人。

items.en: Home safety focuses on preventing accidents and reacting well to dangers in order to protect the safety of the family.
items.zh: 居家安全的重点，是预防事故、妥善应对危险，保护全家人的安全。

items.en: Technology can be good or bad.
items.zh: 科技有好有坏。

items.en: That’s why learning to be cybersafe is so important!
items.zh: 所以学会安全上网特别重要！

items.en: Never give out private information online.
items.zh: 绝不要在网上泄露个人信息。

items.en: Question the information you read.
items.zh: 看到的信息要多问几个为什么。

items.en: Most of us have our names and photos on social media.
items.zh: 我们大多数人的名字和照片都在社交媒体上。

items.en: But without the right privacy settings, they can be used by dangerous people.
items.zh: 可隐私设置没调好，就可能被坏人利用。

items.en: Everything you post or send online could be taken and used against your will.
items.zh: 你在网上发或传的任何东西，都可能被拿去、违背你的意愿使用。

items.en: And once it’s online, it’s nearly impossible to get rid of it completely!
items.zh: 而且一旦上网，几乎不可能彻底删干净！

items.en: Also be careful of what others send you.
items.zh: 别人发来的东西也要当心。

items.en: If you click a link or open an attachment, it can be something dangerous for your computer, like a virus.
items.zh: 点开链接或附件，可能给电脑带来危险，比如病毒。

items.en: The internet era makes gathering information easy.
items.zh: 互联网时代，找信息很容易。

items.en: But you must consider the source of the information you are reading.
items.zh: 但你得想想信息的来源。

items.en: Who published it, a stranger or an expert in the field?
items.zh: 是谁发的，陌生人还是这一领域的专家？

items.en: What website is it on, a blog or a government resource?
items.zh: 登在什么网站，博客还是政府资料？

items.en: Does it offer different views?
items.zh: 它呈现了不同观点吗？

items.en: Is it meant to inform you, or simply get a quick reaction?
items.zh: 是为了告诉你事实，还是只想让你一时冲动？

items.en: You probably know that cyberbullying is bullying, but online.
items.zh: 你大概知道，网络欺凌就是发生在网上的欺凌。

items.en: Sending hurtful messages, spreading lies about someone, sharing their private photos... these are easy to do, but they have a huge impact on the victim.
items.zh: 发伤人的消息、散布别人的谣言、转发别人的私密照片……做起来容易，对受害者却影响巨大。

items.en: The best way to deal with cyberbullying is to ignore, block, and delete.
items.zh: 应对网络欺凌最好的办法是：不理、拉黑、删除。

items.en: Telling a trusted adult is also important, especially if someone is threatening you.
items.zh: 告诉信任的大人也很重要，尤其有人威胁你的时候。

items.en: Be kind to others.
items.zh: 善待别人。

items.en: Be careful with your information.
items.zh: 管好自己的信息。

items.en: Think critically about everything you see online.
items.zh: 网上看到的一切都要动脑想想。

items.en: This will ensure you are cybersafe!
items.zh: 这样你就能安全上网啦！
